content.value: Transform the following sentences as asked in brackets.
i) Habib, a man of strict principle, works in a bank. (into complex)
ii) He is aware of his word. (into negative)
ii) No one will deny that he is brave. (Affirmative)
iv) Your play is death to us. (Complex)
v) Since he cares for honesty and foresight he can do well in business. (into simple)
vi) Were I a child ! (into assertive)
vii) Try to complete the task as we direct. (into simple)
